model_output:
```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Abita Springs'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Louisiana'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom), true) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ST_Count(clipped_raster, true)) AS total_pixels,
    SUM(ST_Count(ST_Reclass(clipped_raster, 1, '0-259:0,260-:1', '8BUI'), true)) AS above_260_pixels
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT
  ROUND((above_260_pixels::numeric / total_pixels::numeric) * 100, 2) AS percent_area_above_260m
FROM elevation_stats;
```
